summary: Implemented another gate-focused services-listing pass. I also aligned CI closer to the plan by extending the service gate jobs to include the omitted tasks/services regression E2E slice, service a11y/perf smoke coverage, and Chromium visual coverage. Targeted verification for the homepage/SEO/docs changes is green, and the previously deferred targeted suites for SEO/push/delete/store/active-contracts were green earlier in the session. The main remaining local red path is the unstable `ServiceDetailsView.instant-buy.test.ts` harness under aggregate or cold-start runs; it still times out and then cascades into stale-DOM duplicates, so the broader component gate is not fully green yet.
